purpose: Project-independent functional problem classes for agent-harness resolution mining.

exclude: repository-specific workflow nouns without a transferable state/contract
require: a closed issue with an implementation-bearing resolution or linked merged PR
at least one implementation or call-site evidence unit and one validation oracle
a workflow that can be expressed without naming a repository path as the abstraction

classes.name: State continuity and reconstruction
classes.problem: Preserve or reconstruct authoritative state across serialization, checkpoint, replay, recovery, or process boundaries.
classes.genericity: applies to any stateful software system, not only agents

classes.name: Bounded resource and budget control
classes.problem: Keep finite capacity, time, memory, token, output, queue, or retry budgets within an explicit safe envelope.
classes.genericity: applies to any bounded resource or admission policy

classes.name: Structured request and result contract integrity
classes.problem: Keep structured requests, arguments, results, identities, and completion events valid and paired across producer/consumer boundaries.
classes.genericity: applies to APIs, RPC, event streams, plugins, and tools

classes.name: Effect control and isolation
classes.problem: Control effectful operations with explicit authorization, scope, sandbox, trust, and fail-closed behavior.
classes.genericity: applies to any software that performs external or privileged effects

classes.name: Failure recovery and retry
classes.problem: Turn partial, transient, cancelled, timed-out, or ambiguous failures into bounded recovery or an explicit terminal result.
classes.genericity: applies to local, remote, synchronous, and asynchronous operations

classes.name: External interface and capability adaptation
classes.problem: Adapt an external provider, protocol, backend, or capability dialect without leaking incompatible assumptions into the common runtime.
classes.genericity: applies to any external service or protocol integration

classes.name: Configuration and environment resolution
classes.problem: Resolve layered configuration, defaults, environment, profiles, and workspace state once, with explicit precedence and propagation.
classes.genericity: applies to any configurable application or service

classes.name: Extension and resource lifecycle
classes.problem: Discover, load, reload, install, isolate, attribute, and clean up extensible resources without stale or cross-scope state.
classes.genericity: applies to plugins, modules, skills, extensions, adapters, and resource packages

classes.name: Concurrent work coordination
classes.problem: Coordinate parallel, background, delegated, or interleaved work with ownership, join, ordering, cancellation, and exactly-once result semantics.
classes.genericity: applies to any concurrent or distributed workflow

classes.name: Observable validation and diagnostics
classes.problem: Make internal state transitions, failures, progress, accounting, and validation results observable and truthful enough for operators and callers.
classes.genericity: applies to any non-trivial runtime, service, or library
